description: Port the analytics/insight engines to Python (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §7 port band): cross-domain correlations, anomaly detection, hypothesis generation, and data-quality scoring, plus their routes. These are self-contained TS compute today. Runs in parallel with the other port tasklists.

userStories.title: Port correlations + anomaly detection
userStories.description: Reimplement the cross-domain correlation graph and anomaly-detection services + routes on the FastAPI service.
acceptanceCriteria: The correlation and anomaly routes pass the parity tests (same results on the baseline fixtures).
Where the TS used DuckDB as an in-memory TSV mirror, the Python port uses an equivalent (duckdb or a documented substitute) and matches outputs.
Express handlers removed or 501; coverage tracker updated.

userStories.title: Port hypothesis generation + data-quality scoring
userStories.description: Reimplement hypothesis-generation and data-quality-scorer services + routes.
acceptanceCriteria: hypotheses and data-quality routes pass the parity tests.
Numeric outputs match the baseline within a documented tolerance (or exactly where deterministic).
